main_body: dead weeping tree with hanging branches and trunk
top_band: none — vertical strips of hanging branches with no coherent top crown surface
evidence: The tree is drawn as flat vertical strips of brown branches hanging straight down from the top, and the base is a flat horizontal bar (rows 52-55) rather than a foreshortened root spread. There is no 3D crown volume seen from above.

style.evidence: Compared to the rich, voluminous Beodeul reference trees with layered leaf clusters and natural root spreads, the candidate is a collection of 2-3px wide vertical brown strips outlined in near-black, with a crude flat horizontal base and two odd dark blue-black blocks on the trunk (rows 42-45).
